design.terminal_abort_signature_unchanged: bool terminal_abort(const Message&, uint64_t now, bool boundary_proven) noexcept
accessor_contract: Initialized Vehicle only; cancellation supported, cancellation_used and cancellation_pending
No accepted reserved Grant write or tail history
Retired nonce/session/cycle/action token/writer generation exactly match the current snapshot
No additional nonzero assumptions: presence depends on the cancellation phase and exact tuple
Historical local retirement remains true after exact terminal cleanup, but is false for a new nonce/FreshRound, Ground, uninitialized, unretired, or already-written Grant
design.accessor_evidence_limit: begin_cancel is called only after the bridge has actually retired the unwritten action/cycle/lease. The accessor is that local historical tombstone, not a physical RF proof or authority to alter another writer lease.
abort_contract: First valid call irreversibly sets the terminal tombstone and revokes agreement; legacy state, journal, t0 and phase clocks remain untouched
Exact same-tuple duplicate with a currently proven boundary is successful idempotent cleanup, not a new reservation or request
At most one AbortAck is enqueued. ACK queued, dequeued-but-unpublished, and committed states do not trigger implicit ACK republication
If the initial reply queue lacks space, revocation is retained and false returned; later same-tuple re-evaluation may queue the first ACK after space becomes available
Independent cleanup observation time rejects duplicate-call clock regression without rewriting operational clocks
ACK publication callback requires that this ACK was actually queued; popping the queue alone is not publication
Failed state permits this exact cleanup API only, never normal Handle/Release/PARAM/negotiation restart
design.legacy_expectation_update: An existing duplicate-Abort return-false assertion was explicitly changed to return-true idempotent completion, preserving and strengthening its no-extra-ACK/no-repeated-authority assertions. This is the agreed API semantics update, not removal of a failure test.
design.no_automatic_ack_republication: An already queued/in-flight/published ACK is not replayed merely because the same AbortRequest is seen again. Host per-role Abort attempt maximum is unchanged.

Independent cleanup clock never regresses and the first terminal timestamp stays unchanged
All operational gates remain disabled after terminal cleanup; no new request, fresh retry, release, cancellation, or negotiation authority
Failed Ground cleanup retains GrantWaitExpired first fault, frozen journal, and original request t0

Uninitialized/Prepared/committed/Ground/released/Grant-written/tail/new-nonce cases cannot claim an exact unwritten retired Vehicle slot
Epoch0 and TDD baseline cycle0 remain valid; baseline0 -> fresh reserved cycle1 -> safe cancellation is covered
Existing reservation wire still rejects cycle0 as a complete reservation authority tuple; this repair does not relax that separate semantic contract
Existing legacy reservation, cancellation maximum1, Ground/Vehicle500ms, hold750ms, prepare8000ms, 550ms service floor, and record512/STOP128/Fatal128 ABI tests remain passing
